why: 429 without Retry-After; the visible tests only check the status code.

task.title: Rate limiting middleware
task.goal: Limit each API key to 100 requests per minute
acceptance: WHEN a key exceeds 100 requests in a minute THEN the API SHALL answer 429 with a Retry-After header in seconds.
Requests to /healthz SHALL never be limited.

hidden.detail: expected header retry-after to be present
